dialogues.jp:
「……はぁ〜、天気のいい日曜は公園に限る
　なぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Whew! There's nothing better than being in the park when
it's good weather on a Sunday."
dialogues.text:
"Whew! There's nothing better than being in the park when
it's good weather on a Sunday."

dialogues.jp:
自販機で買った缶のお茶をしばきながら、つま
みに和菓子を出して口にする。
dialogues.en:
Drinking a can of green tea from a vending machine, I took
out a snack as a nibble.
dialogues.text:
Drinking a can of green tea from a vending machine, I took
out a snack as a nibble.

dialogues.jp:
ジジ臭いとは思うが、こうしないともったいな
いようないい陽気なのだ。
dialogues.en:
I know you think I'm like an old man, but I feel like doing
something because the weather is too nice.
dialogues.text:
I know you think I'm like an old man, but I feel like doing
something because the weather is too nice.

dialogues.jp:
暑すぎない日差しとか、肌をなでる風とか、そ
の風に舞い散る桜とか――。
dialogues.en:
The sun is not too hot, the wind is pleasant on the skin,
and the cherry blossoms are flying high.
dialogues.text:
The sun is not too hot, the wind is pleasant on the skin,
and the cherry blossoms are flying high.

dialogues.jp:
散歩する犬も、走り回る子供も、草むらで雑誌
を顔にのせて寝ている人も笑っている。
dialogues.en:
Everybody is smiling -- even dogs walking along, children
running around and people sleeping on the grass with
magazines on their faces.
dialogues.text:
Everybody is smiling -- even dogs walking along, children
running around and people sleeping on the grass with
magazines on their faces.

dialogues.jp:
テストも終わり、後は来週を適当に過ごすだけ
で学園も春休みにはいる。
dialogues.en:
The final exam is over, all I need to do is make it through
next week until the spring break comes.
dialogues.text:
The final exam is over, all I need to do is make it through
next week until the spring break comes.

dialogues.jp:
こうなると、もぅ、全身からかったるいオーラ
を放出しているだけでいいのだから楽だ。
dialogues.en:
At this point, I just let out all negative auras from my
body.
dialogues.text:
At this point, I just let out all negative auras from my
body.

dialogues.jp: 背後の茂みの中で鈴の音が鳴る。
dialogues.en: I heard the sound of a bell coming from a bush.
dialogues.text: I heard the sound of a bell coming from a bush.

dialogues.en: "Nemu... no, it can't be, it must be a cat."
dialogues.text: "Nemu... no, it can't be, it must be a cat."

dialogues.jp:
いくらアイツだって、こんな日曜に俺を尾行す
るほど暇では有るまい。
dialogues.en:
I don't think she has enough free time to tail my ass even
if she wanted to.
dialogues.text:
I don't think she has enough free time to tail my ass even
if she wanted to.

dialogues.en: ◆Temptation by the sound of a bell◆
dialogues.text: ◆Temptation by the sound of a bell◆

dialogues.jp:
日曜日、テストのウサを晴らすように公園をぶ
らついていると、草むらの中から鈴の音が響い
てきた。
dialogues.en:
I took a stroll through the park on Sunday to get the exam
stress out of my system.
dialogues.text:
I took a stroll through the park on Sunday to get the exam
stress out of my system.

dialogues.jp:
まさか音夢がそんなところには居ないだろうと
思いつつ、なぜかそれが気になってしまって。
dialogues.en: I knew Nemu couldn't be there, but I started to feel uneasy.
dialogues.text: I knew Nemu couldn't be there, but I started to feel uneasy.
